EMAIL_BOUNCE_HIGH.title: {{rate}} of emails bounced — clean the list before the next run
EMAIL_BOUNCE_HIGH.text: Invalid or unused addresses hurt your sender reputation. Remove them so later emails keep reaching inboxes.

critical.text: This is very high and can get your sending blocked. Remove invalid addresses before anything else goes out.

EMAIL_COMPLAINTS.title_one: 1 person marked an email as spam
EMAIL_COMPLAINTS.title_other: {{count}} people marked an email as spam
EMAIL_COMPLAINTS.text: Stop emailing them and review the wording and where the list came from. Complaints damage your sender reputation quickly.

WHATSAPP_FAILED_HIGH.title: {{rate}} of WhatsApp messages failed to deliver
WHATSAPP_FAILED_HIGH.text: Check that the phone numbers are valid and that the template is still approved.

OPT_OUTS.text: Look at the messages that triggered this. Several opt-outs in a day usually mean the wording or the timing needs a rethink.

CREDITS_LOW.title: Credits run out in {{runway}}
CREDITS_LOW.text: Based on your spend over the last 7 days. Top up soon to keep messages going out.

critical.text: Based on your spend over the last 7 days. Top up now to avoid interruptions.

whatsapp.text: Your WhatsApp provider doesn’t report delivery or read receipts, so those figures show as “Not tracked”.
